title: Universal base-change counits on distinguished triangle cohomology
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings in one universe, with R-algebra structures on A and B and an E=A tensor_R B-algebra structure on C. Assume C is E-flat. Choose derived categories of R-, A- and B-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let T be an A-cochain triangle whose image in D(A) is distinguished. Choose arbitrary universal base-derived tensor cohomology models m1,m2,m3 of its three vertices [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Write F for termwise extension A to E to C and J for extension E to C [def-weil-module-base-change]. For each integer i there are maps between J(m1.Hi), J(m2.Hi), J(m3.Hi), J(m1.H(i+1)), J(m2.H(i+1)) forming an exact five-term sequence. The five specified localizedComparison maps commute with the four arrows H^i(F(T.mor1)), H^i(F(T.mor2)), homologyδOfTriangle(F(T),i,i+1), H^(i+1)(F(T.mor1)). There is no coefficient tensor factor or invertibility assumption.

proof.text: Restrict the distinguished triangle to R and apply the exact universal derived scalar extension to B supplied by exists_baseDerivedExtension_resolution. Identify each prescribed universal functor with this common functor by counit uniqueness. Its long exact cohomology sequence is exact. Naturality at A-multiplication and B-linearity make its arrows E-linear; exact scalar restriction reflects exactness. Extend to C, preserving exactness by E-flatness.

Use a functorial K-flat resolution for the counit: its augmentation commutes with shifts, so it induces a triangle morphism to termwise extension. Transport this compatibility through the unique universal derived-functor isomorphisms. Homology naturality gives all four squares, including the boundary. The models comparison_eq and localized_eq identify the maps after transposition under scalar adjunction. This proves compatibility with the specified ordinary triangle boundary, without requiring the extended triangle to be termwise exact.

theorem exists_baseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel_triangle_rows
    (R A B C : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) C]
    [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)] [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    (hC : Module.Flat (A ⊗[R] B) C)
    (T : Pretriangulated.Triangle (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ))
    (hT : DerivedCategory.Q.mapTriangle.obj T ∈ Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles)
    (m₁ : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B T.obj₁ C)
    (m₂ : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B T.obj₂ C)
    (m₃ : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B T.obj₃ C) (i : ℤ) :
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)
    let E := extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C)
    ∃ (s₀ : E.obj (m₁.cohomology i) ⟶ E.obj (m₂.cohomology i))
      (s₁ : E.obj (m₂.cohomology i) ⟶ E.obj (m₃.cohomology i))
      (s₂ : E.obj (m₃.cohomology i) ⟶ E.obj (m₁.cohomology (i + 1)))
      (s₃ : E.obj (m₁.cohomology (i + 1)) ⟶ E.obj (m₂.cohomology (i + 1))),
      (ComposableArrows.mk₄ s₀ s₁ s₂ s₃).Exact ∧
      s₀ ≫ m₂.localizedComparison i =
        m₁.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (F.map T.mor₁) i ∧
      s₁ ≫ m₃.localizedComparison i =
        m₂.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (F.map T.mor₂) i ∧
      s₂ ≫ m₁.localizedComparison (i + 1) = m₃.localizedComparison i ≫
        CochainComplex.homologyδOfTriangle (F.mapTriangle.obj T) i (i + 1) ∧
      s₃ ≫ m₂.localizedComparison (i + 1) = m₁.localizedComparison (i + 1) ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (F.map T.mor₁) (i + 1)
